description: Versioned public boundary of the Mage Home building module. The Python package, the Java/Fabric executor and the Steve controller speak exactly this contract. Changing an operation, a field name or an error code requires the agreement of every consumer before a change.

transport.port: ephemeral; the effective port is published in <gameDir>/config/mage_home/control-port.json
transport.framing: one request and one response per connection; UTF-8 JSON, LF separated; no embedded raw newlines
transport.authentication: The private control-port.json also carries a per-client random token. Pass it in the envelope; do not copy the receipt into logs or reports.
transport.note: The transport is an implementation detail of this contract revision. The operation names, the payload fields and the error codes below are the contract.

start.summary: Accepts a building request quickly and returns projectId/runId without waiting for the work.

request.requestId: string, required, unique per logical request; a repeated requestId with an identical payload returns the existing run
request.description: string, optional; the free text of the house; mutually usable with blueprint
request.blueprint: object, optional; an already compiled blueprint (see spec/blueprint-schema-v5.json)
request.context: object, required; the world identity, the anchor and the available capabilities (see spec/blueprint-schema-v5.json#/definitions/context)

response_result.accepted: boolean; true when the request was taken, false when it was rejected
response_result.duplicate: boolean; true when requestId already existed and the existing run was preserved
response_result.state: run state at the moment of the answer
response_result.generation: integer; the generation of the run, incremented on every resume
response_result.schemaRevision: integer; the revision of the blueprint this run is bound to

rejections.stale_world: the context names a world that is not the world of the client right now
rejections.unsupported_operation: the request asks for something the module does not do
rejections.invalid_request: a required field is missing or malformed
rejections.duplicate_conflict: the requestId exists with a different payload
rejections.not_initialized: the client is not ready to accept work

status.summary: Returns the last snapshot of a run. It never starts work.

request.runId: string, required; the empty string means the current run

response_result.phase: the current phase of the run

sitePreparation.access: string; the confirmed state of the entrance access

response_result.waitingReason: string or null; why the run does not act right now
response_result.controlReleased: boolean; true when the module holds no game input

pause.summary: Stops new game actions and revokes the permission of the module. The progress, the plan and the equipment are kept.

response_result.controlReleased: boolean; the module released its game input
response_result.releaseLatencyTicks: integer; the processed client ticks between the request and the release

pause.note: accepted is not controlReleased. The release must happen within two processed client ticks and must not wait for a task, for a cleanup, for a disk write or for a network answer.

resume.summary: Continues the same run after the world and the control availability were checked again.

rejections.run_terminal: the run was stopped; a stopped project needs a new explicit start

stop.summary: Makes the run terminal and revokes new actions. The cleanup debt is kept.

response_result.cancellationReason: string; the structured reason of the stop

stop.note: A stopped run is never revived by a late model answer, by the end of a fight or by a reconnect. Continuing a stopped project requires a new explicit start.

moduleStop.summary: Stops the current builder run if it has not ended. Does not change moduleEnabled or touch other addons.

disable.summary: Performs moduleStop and prevents new builder runs until enable.

enable.summary: Permits future explicit starts. Never resumes or starts any run.

capabilities.summary: Describes what the module can do in the client right now.

response_result.engine: string or null; selected client executor, for lab diagnostics

unionClef.currentChain: string or null; the chain that the scheduler of UnionClef selected
unionClef.userChainHeld: boolean; true when the user chain of UnionClef is the selected one
unionClef.currentTask: string or null; the task that the user chain holds

ui.screenOpen: boolean; the module pauses while a screen is open
ui.screen: string or null; the class of the open screen

error.code: one of the rejection codes of the operation

global_rules.idempotency: A repeated requestId with an identical payload preserves the existing run and reports duplicate=true. A repeated requestId with a different payload is rejected with duplicate_conflict.
global_rules.world_binding: A run is bound to the world identity of its context. A run whose context names another world is rejected before any mutation.
global_rules.control_budget: Pause and Stop release the game input of the module within two processed client ticks.
global_rules.tokens: Every run carries a run token, a generation and a lease. A callback of an older generation or of an ended run never receives a new permit.
global_rules.ownership: A module-wide stop affects only the jobs of the builder. The global control of other addons belongs to the caller.
global_rules.terminal_states: STOPPED, BLOCKED, FAILED and READY are terminal for the run of that generation.
